about:
LA Packaging was founded in 1984 by Edward Loritz Sr. in Yorba Linda, California. The company began with a commitment to supply American-made hinged-lid plastic containers at affordable prices, a mission that continues under family leadership today.

The company manufactures clarified polypropylene, polyethylene, and ESD plastic containers and vials, primarily using injection molding. Its product lines include hinged-lid containers, ESD-inhibiting containers, and custom options such as hot stamping and labeling. Production capabilities have expanded to serve customers across North America, Europe, and Asia, though specific facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

LA Packaging serves the electronics, medical, pharmaceutical, food, laboratory, and industrial sectors. Its containers are designed for applications requiring medical-grade Class VI polypropylene that is REACH, RoHS, and FDA compliant. The company also operates two e-commerce sites: lacontainerstore.com for bulk orders (domestic only) and esdplasticcontainers.com for small-quantity purchases with no minimum order.

The founder’s original emphasis on high-quality, U.S.-made materials that do not leach or degrade remains a stated differentiator. LA Packaging highlights its use of medical-grade polypropylene, compliance with REACH and RoHS, and a customer-service approach that includes Net 30 terms and direct phone support.
